sentences.text: Puntanipterus is an extinct pterodactyloid pterosaur found in the La Cruz Formation of San Luis, Argentina. Its leg bones resemble those of Pterodaustro but feature an expanded spherical ankle joint and spiny processes on the tibia.
The species name means "spherical" in Latin, referring to the unique shape of the lower tibia.

The genus Puntanipterus was named in 1975 by José Bonaparte and Teresa Sánchez. The type species of the genus is Puntanipterus globosus. The genus name combines "Puntanos," the colloquial name for inhabitants of San Luis province, with the Greek word for wing.
In 1978, Bonaparte classified Puntanipterus as a member of the family Pterodaustridae. In 1980, Peter Galton concluded that Puntanipterus belonged to the family Dsungaripteridae.
Puntanipterus lived from the Late Jurassic to the Early Cretaceous and was found in the La Cruz Formation of San Luis, Argentina.

South American researchers argue that Puntanipterus and Pterodaustro are identical forms based on tibia comparisons. Codorniú and Chiappe suggested in 2004 that Puntanipterus is a junior synonym of Pterodaustro. A 2009 study classified Puntanipterus as a valid dsungaripterid genus with morphology similar to Noripterus.
